scope: Read-only review of the exact R10 execution record and raw Nextest streams. Do not rerun Cargo, Nextest, or tests; do not make product qualification claims.
review_checks: Independently hash raw stdout, stderr, supervisor.exit, and run-result.json; confirm raw stream sizes and hashes match the result record.
Confirm stdout is empty and stderr contains exactly one PASS for checked_in_records_render_from_exact_copies, 45 skipped, and Nextest summary 1 passed / 45 skipped.

Confirm result argv/environment/test filter match the reviewed runner and Root-reported invocation. Verify from the runner source that checkInputs runs before spawn; do not claim the result JSON itself embeds runner/source hashes.
State the measured scope as one fresh-clone status report test only; this does not qualify the product or the full status suite.
execution_binding_limit: run-result.json contains the exact argv/workdir/environment but does not embed the runner binary hash or a copy of the pre-spawn checkInputs report. The reviewed runner performs checkInputs before starting Nextest, and Root reports invoking its pinned path. Keep this provenance boundary explicit.
